summary_en: Kamgras 1 K.K. raised its public takeover offer price for Kakaku.com Inc. to 3,680 yen per share from 3,571 yen, and extended the offer period to September 29, 2026, for a total of 95 business days.
title_en: Notice Regarding Changes to Offer Terms and Conditions for Public Takeover Bid for Common Shares and Subscription Rights to Shares of Kakaku.com Inc. by Kamgras 1 K.K.
translation_en_brief:
Kamgras 1 K.K., the offeror in a public takeover bid for Kakaku.com Inc. initiated on May 13, 2026, increased the offer price per share to 3,680 yen from the previous price of 3,571 yen as of August 27, 2026. The offeror filed a revised public takeover notice on September 10, 2026. Concurrent with this price increase, the offeror extended the offer period to September 29, 2026, with a total of 95 business days from the start of the bid.

The offeror stated that the price increase was decided after comprehensively considering market price developments in Kakaku.com shares, the subscription status and outlook for further subscriptions from shareholders and subscription rights holders, and the objective of providing shareholders with more attractive sale opportunities while heightening the likelihood of the bid's success. The offeror views the revised bid terms as superior to a competing proposal announced on July 29, 2026, in terms of likelihood of completion and timing of realization.
